Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial bank evidence and remit sample for Redwood onboarding

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Thanks for walking us through the onboarding checklist yesterday. Finance at TrustBridge is ready to complete the vendor setup; to finish our banking enrollment they asked for two quick items:

- A short bank cover letter or routing confirmation from Redwood (bank letter)
- A sample remittance file showing how invoice numbers will map to PO fields for our AR system

I've attached the bank cover we usually send for vendors (TrustBridge_Bank_Cover.pdf) — that contains TrustBridge bank details for your records. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a virtual account string or if standard ACH routing/account is preferred? Also please confirm the exact PO field we should include on remittances so our AR team can map correctly.

We need to schedule first payment for 05/03; would like to confirm micro-deposit timing so we can run the ACH test.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Finance Operations Manager
TrustBridge Inc.

Attachment: TrustBridge_Bank_Cover.pdf (PDF, 58 KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@trustbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial bank evidence and remit sample for Redwood onboarding

Samantha — thanks for the note and the cover.

Quick answers up front:
- We can support both a standard ACH routing/account and a virtual-account style remittance string; for TrustBridge I'd recommend standard ACH (routing + account) unless you prefer to segregate flows by VA.
- For PO mapping, our finance system accepts either PO_NUMBER or PO_REFERENCE in the remittance file; PO_NUMBER is preferred to drive automated match.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx) which includes the field we use for remittance mapping and a sample layout. Please fill sections A & B and return. Once we have the banking info completed we will send two micro-deposits for verification (should appear in 1-2 business days).

I'll loop Jordan in to confirm the payout schedule and to ensure Finance is prepped for a 05/03 run.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (Excel, 32 KB)
